build_LeJEPA_model: build a LeJEPA self-supervised vision transformer learner with a ViT backbone and projector
create_NetWrapper_encoder: create a NetWrapper that hooks into a ViT backbone to extract hidden layer embeddings with a projection head
create_MLP_projector: create an MLP projector network with configurable layers, hidden size, and L2-normalized output
test_sigreg_loss: test the sigreg loss function that computes a characteristic-function-based regularization loss
run_LeJEPA_training: run LeJEPA training with local and global augmented crops, MSE invariance loss, and sigreg loss
